SELECT s.*, p.plan_no, p.plan_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dtl_attendance a WHERE a.session_id = s.id AND a.deleted = FALSE AND a.attend_status = #{presentStatus}) AS actual_attendee_count, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dtl_attendance a WHERE a.session_id = s.id AND a.deleted = FALSE) AS attendance_imported FROM biz_training_session s JOIN biz_training_plan p ON p.id = s.plan_id
ORDER BY s.${sortColumn} ${sortDirection} NULLS LAST, s.start_time, s.id DESC LIMIT #{q.pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
